sn47.19:1.1: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling among the Sumbhas, where there was a town of the Sumbhas named Sedaka.
sn47.19:1.2: There the Blessed One addressed the bhikkhus thus:
sn47.19:1.3: “Bhikkhus, once in the past an acrobat set up his bamboo pole and addressed his apprentice Medakathalika thus:
sn47.19:1.4: ‘Come, dear Medakathalika, climb the bamboo pole and stand on my shoulders.’
sn47.19:1.5: Having replied, ‘Yes, teacher,’ the apprentice Medakathalika climbed up the bamboo pole and stood on the teacher’s shoulders.
sn47.19:1.6: The acrobat then said to the apprentice Medakathalika:
sn47.19:1.7: ‘You protect me, dear Medakathalika, and I’ll protect you.
sn47.19:1.8: Thus guarded by one another, protected by one another, we’ll display our skills, collect our fee, and get down safely from the bamboo pole.’
sn47.19:1.9: When this was said, the apprentice Medakathalika replied: ‘That’s not the way to do it, teacher.
sn47.19:1.11: You protect yourself, teacher, and I’ll protect myself.
sn47.19:1.12: Thus, each self-guarded and self-protected, we’ll display our skills, collect our fee, and get down safely from the bamboo pole.’
sn47.19:2.1: “That’s the method there,” the Blessed One said. “It’s just as the apprentice Medakathalika said to the teacher.
sn47.19:2.2: ‘I will protect myself,’ bhikkhus: thus should the establishments of mindfulness be practised.
sn47.19:2.3: ‘I will protect others,’ bhikkhus: thus should the establishments of mindfulness be practised.
sn47.19:2.4: Protecting oneself, bhikkhus, one protects others; protecting others, one protects oneself.
sn47.19:3.1: “And how is it, bhikkhus, that by protecting oneself one protects others?
sn47.19:3.2: By the pursuit, development, and cultivation of the four establishments of mindfulness. It is in such a way that by protecting oneself one protects others.
sn47.19:3.4: bhikkhus, that by protecting others one protects oneself?
sn47.19:3.5: By patience, harmlessness, lovingkindness, and sympathy.
sn47.19:3.6: It is in such a way that by protecting others one protects oneself.
sn47.19:3.7: “‘I will protect myself,’ bhikkhus: thus should the establishments of mindfulness be practised.
sn47.19:3.8: ‘I will protect others,’ bhikkhus: thus should the establishments of mindfulness be practised.
sn47.19:3.9: Protecting oneself, bhikkhus, one protects others; protecting others, one protects oneself.”
